review.summary: Adds the DiscordOpsAlert notifier with redaction, multibyte-safe 1800-character truncation and soft-fail logging, together with the audit/daily logging configuration, env keys, phpunit pin and an ops decision guide. The implementation matches the task and is clean, but it ships without any Pest/PHPUnit tests, which the project's non-negotiable TDD convention requires for all new behavior, and the logging docs/CHANGELOG are not fully kept in sync. It needs changes before merging.
